{{Short description|Romanian chemist (1937–2026)}}
{{expand Romanian|topic=bio|Ionel Haiduc|date=February 2015}}
'''Ionel Haiduc''' (9 May 1937 – 29 September 2026) was a Romanian chemist who was elected to the [[Romanian Academy]] and [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova]]. He was the President of the [[Romanian Academy]] between 2006 and 2014. Haiduc was more well known for his contributions to Organometallic Chemistry.

Haiduc died on 29 September 2026, at the age of 89.<ref>{{Cite web |title=A murit academicianul Ionel Haiduc (fișă biografică) |url=https://agerpres.ro/documentare/2026/09/29/a-murit-academicianul-ionel-haiduc-fisa-biografica--1597922 |access-date=2026-09-29 |website=agerpres|language=ro}}</ref>

* {{flagicon|Romania}} [[House of Romania|Romanian Royal Family]]: Knight of the [[Decorations of the Romanian Royal House#Royal Decoration of the Cross of the Romanian Royal House|Royal Decoration of the Cross of the Romanian Royal House]]<ref name="OrdersWorn">curentul.ro, [http://www.curentul.ro/2008/images/stories/2008/22-12/12/13%20Acad%20Ionel%20Haiduc.jpg wearing his orders]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://casamajestatiisale.ro/familia-regala/ordine-decoraii/crucea-casei-regale-a-romaniei/|title=Crucea Casei Regale a României}}</ref>
* {{flagicon|Romania}} [[Romania|Romanian Republic]]: Grand Cross of the [[Order of the Star of Romania]]<ref name="OrdersWorn" /><ref>{{Cite web| url=http://cdn.citynews.ro/sites/default/files/styles/442x293/public/field/image/haiduc_0.jpg | title=Ionel Haiduc during a ceremony | access-date=2016-03-19 | archive-date=2014-08-25 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140825024015/http://cdn.citynews.ro/sites/default/files/styles/442x293/public/field/image/haiduc_0.jpg | url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url=http://diplomatic-economist.eu/wp-content/uploads/haiduc_muresan.jpg | title=Ional Haiduc shakes hands | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151106065418/http://diplomatic-economist.eu/wp-content/uploads/haiduc_muresan.jpg | archive-date=2015-11-06 | format=JPG | website=diplomatic-economist.eu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web| title=Ionel Haiduc | url=http://www.caleaeuropeana.ro/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/IHaiduc.jpg | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160328102641/http://www.caleaeuropeana.ro/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/IHaiduc.jpg | archive-date=2016-03-28}}</ref>
